Compute on a 2D grid.
- Initialize pos=(0,0), head=(0,1); base=(0,1).
- always = text contains "Always face forward" (case-insensitive).
- Process instructions in order.
  - Turns: "Turn left/right/around" change facing only; if always, ignore turns. left=90° CCW, right=90° CW, around=180°.
  - Moves: "Take N step(s)" optionally with "forward/backward/left/right".
    - N = the integer in the instruction.
    - Use f = base if always else head.
    - Direction d:
      - forward or omitted: d = f
      - backward: d = -f
      - left: d = (-f.y, f.x)
      - right: d = (f.y, -f.x)
    - pos += N * d
- Output True iff pos == (0,0). Ignore final facing. Ignore unrelated text and punctuation.
